title: SIMPLE FM -- teaching patch for 2-operator (Chowning) FM synthesis

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Click the keys to play (click height = velocity), or play a MIDI keyboard.
Notes sound while held and fade out when released.
The menu under the keyboard changes the keyboard mode.
ratio: modulator frequency = carrier x ratio.
Whole-number ratios sound harmonic, fractional ones sound inharmonic or bell-like.
index: modulation depth. Higher = more sidebands = brighter.
carrier / modulator / deviation readouts show the FM math in Hz as you play.
preset: loads a tone (E-Piano, Bell, Bass, Brass, Marimba, Glass) by setting ratio and index.
engine A/B: switch between the MSP chain and the gen~ codebox. They should sound the same.
waveform and spectrum: watch the sidebands spread as you raise index.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: A sine modulator at carrier x ratio is scaled by the deviation (modulator x index).
That signal is added to the carrier frequency, which drives a second sine: the carrier.
The patching view shows this as plain cycle~ / *~ / +~ objects, with a gen~ copy beside it.
A line~ envelope (about 10 ms attack, 200 ms release) follows the key velocity.
